messages:
emma.support: Alert - HelioCare trial onboarding failing for vector uploads. Customers seeing intermittent 502s and item-level timeouts during bulk import. Renewal sync scheduled in 4 days, flagging as urgent. :exclamation:
rachel.cs: thanks. hosted or dedicated? can you paste an error snippet and volume profile?
emma.support: Hosted. burst ~260 reqs/min during their import job. sample: 
```
HTTP 502 Bad Gateway
{"error":"worker-pool-exhausted", "route":"/v1/embeddings", "tenant":"helio_trial"}
```
we also saw SDK retries and some 504s.
tony.eng: sounds like worker pool exhaustion combined with large sequence lengths. short mitigations we can do: 1) route tenant to a dedicated burst pool for 24h, 2) enable request-shaping (max-parallel per-connection) on their tenant, 3) enable prefix KV caching for repeated docs. ops can we do the pool move?
emma.support: paging ops-bot for pool move and request-shaping for helio_trial.
ops-bot: Requested pool move to burst-capacity for tenant helio_trial. Change id: pool-2026-08-14-09
ops-bot: Pool move applied: helio_trial -> burst-capacity-eu. Request-shaping set to max_conn=6.
emma.support: telemetry update after move: 502s dropped to <1.5%, 504s very rare. p95 latency improved from ~2.8s to ~640ms. single fail during the cutover.
rachel.cs: good. CS comms plan (concise): 1) immediate customer message with apology, what changed, and single-point contact; 2) 30m tech review with eng+support within 24h; 3) offer a one-week trial extension and exec check-in depending on outcome; 4) follow-up RCA and playbook for bulk uploads. I'll draft the note now.
kevin.am: I'll own renewal conversation and suggested commercial gestures. please include an estimate of the cost for the temporary pool bump.
tony.eng: RCA bullets for customer-facing doc: - Cause: bulk import burst exhausted worker pool due to sequence length variance and lack of tenant-level shaping. - Temporary mitigation: moved tenant to burst pool + limited per-connection parallelism + enabled prefix caching. - Next steps: implement tenant-aware autoscaler, add server-side bulk path with higher concurrency, and SDK guidance for staggered uploads.
rachel.cs: owners: CS (rachel) send customer note + invite; Support (emma) confirm ops changes + monitor; Eng (tony) produce RCA draft in 48h; AM (kevin) prepare renewal play options; Ops retain pool change until eng confirms permanent fix (pool-2026-08-14-09).
emma.support: meeting scheduled 2026-08-15 11:00 UTC, invites sent to HelioCare technical lead + AM + eng.
notify-bot: Severity label updated: P1 (renewal-watch)
ops-bot: Retention note: pool-2026-08-14-09 retained until 2026-08-21 or when resolved.
rachel.cs: adding feedback link to invite: https://forms.redwood/helio-onboard-feedback
kevin.am: customer replied: "Thanks for fast action. We need a written playbook before prod ramp and an SLA on bulk imports." tagged CS + eng.
rachel.cs: thanks team — will send the customer note now and close after RCA + postmortem + feedback captured. :white_check_mark:
